decision_record.decision: User elected to bypass the physical socket coupon and use a conservative printed allowance.
mitigations: Increase the straight socket opening to 21.0 x 21.0 mm.
Add a 1.0 mm deep 45-degree lead-in expanding the mouth to 23.0 x 23.0 mm.
Retain the M4 cross-bolt to locate the rail; permit a thin hidden-face shim if physical rattle is unacceptable.
accepted_residual_risks: No geometry can guarantee fit against unmeasured tube burrs, damage, printer calibration, or ASA shrink.
The larger allowance can produce perceptible unbolted rattle before the M4 fastener is installed.
